biotools.summary: The Hydractinia Genome Project Portal provides a spatially validated single-cell atlas of Hydractinia symbiolongicarpus, offering insights into cellular diversity, dynamics, and developmental processes. The resource integrates new datasets with previously published data and includes various data analysis tools and resources for researchers.
